t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the knomes are linked to different coloured baskets, once you work out which basket is linked to what coloured gnome then you will get more points

vb_textbox.text: once you work out which gnome and which baskets go together then you will get more point, I found that the red, purple, light brown all gave you more points with the red basket and the blue, green gnomes give you more points with the yellow basket
